Overall, the balance supports IDH-mutant status.

The nonenhancing, non-necrotic, solitary cortical lesion in a young adult most strongly supports a lower-grade IDH-mutant diffuse glioma. 1p/19q status is the least certain because several discriminating imaging features are unavailable.
